description: Custom Kali Linux container with Cursor IDE, Microsoft Edge, custom desktop background, and auto-launch configuration. Includes DNS configuration and support for additional Kali security tools.
notes: Requires root user. Custom DNS (10.10.10.1) configured. Cursor IDE auto-launches on login. Microsoft Edge pre-installed. Custom desktop background. Supports apt package management for additional Kali tools. Configure S3 persistent storage for per-user profiles.
